messages:
marie: Quick bulletin: extending the EOQ release freeze by 48h to roll a critical kernel patch on parts of the GPU fleet. Observed canary instability on embeddings in canary-2 — transient OOMs + RPS spike. Hold non-urgent deploys.

devon: Which services/regions should we avoid touching?

marie: Targeted: gpu-fleet nodes backing model-router clusters in us-west. Canary-2 is the main affected group. Not a full-region outage but treat as high priority.

gina: Confirming failed canaries: 3/5 in canary-2, logs indicate KV cache thrash -> memory pressure. I've paused further canary promotions.

release-bot: Canary group 'canary-2' paused by gina at 2025-11-04T09:22Z.

samir: Plan: patch one canary node, monitor 30-60m, then stagger. @ops-oncall will run the validation checklist. If green, roll remainder with 20m staggers.

ops-oncall: Starting patch on first node now. Will post checklist output and metric snapshots here in ~40m.

marie: Exception flow if you need to ship during freeze:
```
/permit-deploy EOQ-KERNEL --pr <URL> --reason "urgent prod OOM fix"
```
Must include: rollback plan, smoke tests, approvals by eng-sre lead + release mgr.

devon: Can we mitigate by throttling routes to ease pressure on canary-2?

gina: Yes. Throttle embeddings (/v1/embed) and search-reorder for canary-2. Suggest soft quota ~20 rps per token and reduce client batch sizes.

marie: Updated runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-freeze-extend (internal only). Freeze now ends Mon 15:00 UTC, auto-unfreeze disabled.

release-bot: Freeze extended 48h. New unfreeze: Mon 15:00 UTC. Auto-unfreeze: OFF.

samir: I'll own post-patch canary validation and report back.

ops-oncall: First node patched. 30m observation passed: no OOMs, CPU stable. Proceeding with staggered roll (3 nodes, 20m interval). Posting metric graphs in ops dashboard.

gina: Favorable. Re-enable canary expansion only after 2h of full-roll stability + green smoke tests. Marie please gate.

marie: Gate confirmed. Thanks team. If anyone sees regressions, escalate in this thread and add a brief summary to the postmortem doc after rollout completes.
